title: RS Encoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/RS_Encoder.md
text: Encode message to RS codeword, 2 inputs, 3 outputs; {Codeword length (N)} sets the length, {Message length (K)} sets the length, {Source of primitive polynomial} sets the primitive, {Primitive polynomial}, {Source of B, the starting power for roots of the primitive polynomial}, {B value} sets the starting, {Enable puncturing} sets the puncture and {Puncture pattern vector} sets the puncture vector 1.
